profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Prodea Systems
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer networking industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in DEV-OPS, SOAP, HTML, Linux, XML, and Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
o	Adapted and updated legacy controls of, loadbuild, packaging and defecting management functions for    software control management paradigms including but not limited to concepts of branching, streaming, labeling, vaulting; for all phases of the development life cycle from initial development through integration, verification, final compile and post-release support.
o	Responsible for development, maintenance, management and production of entire loadbuild environment.
o	Successfully manage builds on Redhat and Centos on Intel x86, for an embedded Linux kernel for Sigma-based, and MIPS Digital Media Adapters, .NET applications targeted for Windows , OS X applications, iOS(iPhone and iPad,), and Android applications.
o	All builds unified through continuous compilation using Jenkins on appropriate servers. Streamlined Subversion Repository of corporate code base including redesign, and coding of build and package for flexibility, providing for quick and efficient identification of source code revisions that take part in generating build artifacts. Created migration plan and have migrated multiple svn repositories to git.
o	Updated and expanded custom packaging system to allow for efficient packaging of various system components into a single identifiable distribution load. Expanded the system to handle new generational builds dynamically.
o	Responsible for signing and publishing all software to various distribution areas.  
o	Developed, deployed and managed collection of tools used in the software development process, integrating the revision control software(git, svn), compliers, cross-compliers, loadbuild, packaging tools and issue managment. 
o	Modified the continuous compile process to work seamlessly across multiple servers and provide feedback to software code owners. Also added tracking of success or failure to trigger nightly builds only when needed for portions of the packages that are updated infrequently.

positions.title: Data Management Expert
positions.description:
o	Data Migration Specialist tasked with insuring that the data migration merging Office data into FedEx corporate standards is successful.
o	Designed and Developed the Test Program for the migration scenario to test ALL the potential areas of migration data from legacy system to the corporate system.
o	Testing all aspects of the migration programming of data to safe guard that all data is passed as directed by the business requirements and specifications.
o	Worked with Business and IT regarding the requirements and specifications so the migration will not compromise the ultimate customer experience when migration occurs.
o	Located and presented data trends that were not taken into account during project design. Then helped with discovery regarding the best method to successfully handle this data.
o	Did detailed data mining to ensure all data and associations that were in the design covered all possible scenarios of existing data.
o	Facilitating communication between working parties to insure the ideal outcome.

positions.title: Manager of Front End Interfaces for Emerging technolgies division
positions.description:
o	Designed and developed complete user interface/database/backend processing to configure the SoftSwitch and associated hardware.
o	Designed and developed Owner master switch interface using Apache Tomcat, JSP, Servlets and multithreaded application level services to handle things like TCP/IP communication to the backend process and a real-time Alarm monitor.
o	Designed and developed JAVA based SOAP Services, designed to handle business logic integration of VoIP system, billing system and voicemail system, accessing and integrating data. Processing data flow through multiple integrated databases and onto the backend processes. Using XML and XSLT to format data as needed.
o	Designed and developed dynamic core PHP framework, based on open source technologies, to enable rapid development of web based applications. 
o	Designed and developed PHP based multi-lingual web based management applications for multiple VoIP business models leveraging the aforementioned SOAP services, PHP framework and open source JavaScript libraries. Systems included would be owner, seller and user level applications for systems including subscriber portals, pbx portals, Sip Trunking portals and necessary functions to maintain these functionalities.
o	Analyzed and designed features, enhancements and new business models interacting with customers to derive requirements.
o	Managed self and small teams of developers to implement new features, enhancements and business models in an efficient and time sensitive manner.
o	Designed and developed JSP/Servelet based application to maintain SoftSwitch and partitioning to leasing entities.
